reason: I'd self-host the free version and play with it for a weekend, but I won't pay $99 a month for a pre-alpha by one developer that runs agents unattended on client code.
objection: Leaving agents alone with our clients' repos overnight is a security risk, and a pre-alpha solo project gives me no reason to trust its sandboxing or gates.
would_change_my_mind: A clear security model (sandboxing, scoped credentials, audit log) plus a few weeks of my own self-hosted runs producing PRs we actually merge.
